articles.summary: CISA 2015, as the law is often called, provides liability protections for companies sharing cyber threat indicators amongst themselves and with federal agencies. It is set to expire next month.

articles.title: Preparations for advanced nuclear at ports should begin now, study concludes

articles.title: First reactor unit launched on Chukotka icebreaker

articles.title: Singapore looks to develop nuclear energy expertise

articles.title: Togo signs nuclear energy MoU with Rosatom
articles.summary: The Ministry of Energy of Togo has signed a memorandum of understanding with Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom to assess opportunities for implementing nuclear power projects.

articles.title: Nuclear fuel delivered for Bangladesh's second unit
articles.summary: Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom says that the initial fuel load for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant's second unit has been delivered.

articles.title: Turkish oil refiner to consider SMR deployment
articles.summary: TÜPRAŞ, Turkey's largest crude oil refiner, has signed an agreement with the US Trade and Development Agency to fund technical assistance to assess the potential of small modular reactors to supply electricity, heat and steam for its refining processes.

articles.title: Westinghouse to conduct key study for AP1000 in Slovakia
articles.summary: Westinghouse is to carry out a Front-End Engineering and Design study for the potential deployment of an AP1000 reactor at the Bohunice Nuclear Power Plant in the Slovak Republic.

articles.title: Uganda and Russia look to move ahead with nuclear project
articles.summary: A roadmap setting out cooperation in the peaceful uses of nuclear energy, as part of work towards a nuclear power plant, has been signed by Russia and Uganda.

articles.title: Texas SMR plant moves to final permitting stage
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission says there will soon be a construction permit announcement after it finished its safety review for the Xe-100 reactor, which is proposed for deployment at the Long Mott Generating Station in Texas.

articles.title: First concrete poured for unit 5 at Haiyang plant
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 5 at the Haiyang nuclear power plant. It is the fifth of six large pressurised water reactors planned for the site in China's Shandong province.

articles.title: PEJ applies for early works permit for nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has applied to the head of the Pomeranian Voivodeship for a permit to start early works required for the construction of Poland's first nuclear power plant at the Lubiatowo-Kopalino site in the Choczewo municipality.

articles.title: Singapore enlists Finnish help in bolstering nuclear expertise
articles.summary: The VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland and the Singapore Nuclear Research and Safety Institute have signed a five-year memorandum of understanding to deepen cooperation in nuclear safety and strengthen the capabilities required to assess emerging nuclear technologies.

articles.title: Turkey and South Korea explore nuclear financing cooperation
articles.summary: A framework to evaluate potential cooperation on the financing of nuclear power projects was one of a number of energy-related initiatives agreed between Turkey and South Korea.

articles.title: Saltfoss targets US licensing for floating power plant
articles.summary: Molten Salt Power Barge developer Saltfoss has notified the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission of its intent to begin pre-application engagement.

articles.title: Initial fuel loading completed at second San'ao unit
articles.summary: The loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 2 at the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province has been completed ahead of its start up. The unit is the second of six HPR1000s (Hualong Ones) planned at the site.

articles.title: Helen to assess environmental impacts of SMR in Helsinki
articles.summary: Finland's Helen Ydinvoima Oy has launched an environmental impact assessment on the construction of a small nuclear power plant at one of three potential sites in Helsinki.

articles.title: IHI to supply components for first Polish AP1000
articles.summary: Japanese engineering firm IHI Corporation has received an order from Westinghouse covering engineering and procurement activities for long-lead items for one containment vessel and an associated large steel module for the first unit of Poland's first nuclear power plant.
